title: Cyclins rise and fall, driving the cycle
caption: A CDK is active only when bound to a cyclin. CDK levels stay steady, but each cyclin builds up before the phase it drives, switches on its CDK, and is then destroyed, which resets the cycle. Different cyclin–CDK complexes control G₁/S, S and M.
alt: Three bell-shaped curves of cyclin level peaking in late G1, in S phase and at the start of M, over a flat line for constant CDK, against bands for the phases of the cell cycle.
description: CDK level: steady all through the cycle.
G₁/S cyclin: peaks at the end of G₁, driving entry to S phase.
S cyclin: peaks in S phase.
M cyclin: peaks at the start of M, then is destroyed so the cycle resets.

checks.name: G₁/S cyclin peaks at the end of G₁
S cyclin peaks in S phase
M cyclin peaks as the cell enters M
M cyclin has been destroyed by the next G₁
